mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past three months compresses discount rates applied to equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods following UNRATE exceeding 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous weakness in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals broad-based demand contraction, predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods following simultaneous HOUST and RSAFS declines exceeding 0.5% from 3-month averages.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising > 0.25pp over 3 months), higher discount rates and reduced corporate profitability drive negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods following a 3-month FEDFUNDS rise exceeding 0.25 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in housing starts (HOUST) over the past three months signals strong consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods following a 3-month HOUST increase exceeding 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 indicates manufacturing contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to supply chain disruptions.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods following INDPRO readings below 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous deceleration in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) signals labor market deterioration, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods following simultaneous PAYEMS growth decline >0.1% MoM and UNRATE rise >0.1pp.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 330.0), a month-over-month CPIAUCSL increase signals persistent inflation, prompting central bank hawkishness and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods following CPIAUCSL exceeding 330.0 and a month-over-month increase.
